name: dsh-jp-vertical-kb
description: Reviewed vertical-Japanese scanned-book ingestion: jp_vertical_prepare fixes workspace identity (title/author checked against the book), jp_vertical_run drives OCR → translate → compile → verify → register with exact-page retry lists and evidence files, jp_vertical_status reports progress, missing pages and acceptance evidence. · 竖排日语扫描书入库：jp_vertical_prepare 建档核对书名作者，jp_vertical_run 按 OCR→翻译→编译→核验→入库分阶段推进（失败页须精确重试，保留证据文件），jp_vertical_status 查进度、缺失页与验收证据。
